brief: A three-storey tower: drawers on the bottom storey and open bins on the top storey.

requirements.evidence: Three pieces stacked at (0,0,0) half-s, (0,0,1) half-s, (0,0,2) half-s - three levels present but check_build reports UNSUPPORTED for piece:0,0,1;half-s and piece:0,0,2;half-s (half-s at 1 and 2 is not held up). MeshClash=clear.
drawer:0#0,0#cut at (0,0,0) level 0, key n on half-s base - drawer exists on bottom storey as required.

requirements.requirement: Open bins on the top storey (level 2)
requirements.evidence: No bin currently placed on level 2. Previous bin bin:0,0,2~hex-bin-half-s-full was removed and not replaced; find_sockets offered hex-bin-half-s-full variants at (0,0,2) but none applied before finish.

finish.summary: Build is a vertical 3-level half-s stack (0,0,0 to 0,0,2) with drawer on bottom met, but top-storey bin missing (unmet) and structural check fails with UNSUPPORTED errors for levels 1 and 2. MeshClash clear.

lines.label: M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
